hypothesis: Full-public, question-blind graph-decomposition supervision identifies which public edges are component-joining 9-node path bridges, enabling the causal online learned memory policy to retain junction evidence under the same 144B cap.

teacher_offline_only.identify_bridge_definition: For each of the 72 public edges, remove it from its original 18-node/17-edge component; mark it a bridge iff the resulting two connected parts each have exactly 9 nodes.
teacher_offline_only.teacher_utility_formula: 0.4*(sum(min(hops,4)^2)/16) + 2.0*(count of exact lossless bridge-edge records retained) + 0.5*(count of future public incidence on distinct retained endpoints / 24) - 0.1*(number of singleton records / 12)
teacher_offline_only.model_features: Exact 16 features of frozen F67A online source, no additional inputs.
teacher_offline_only.labels: For each candidate after-state in ACTION.actions relative to that step's exact F60 successor, feature delta and clipped utility delta in [-1,1]; no synthetic outcome-dependent class resampling or label flipping.
teacher_offline_only.training: Three deterministic chronological SGD epochs, learning rate 0.02, tanh regression, signed-int8 weights round(16*w) and clamp [-127,127], no hyperparameter selection after looking at synthetic outcomes.
teacher_offline_only.fallback: No protected model training unless independent causal synthetic validation demonstrates learned merge and bridge retention plus a positive junction ablation; otherwise block.
